text: かざんの　おおい　ちほうの　みずは　うまいぞ！

structure.jp: かざんの　おおい　ちほうの　みずは
structure.en: the water of a region with many volcanoes

patterns.name: 〜の (subject)
patterns.span: かざんの　おおい　ちほう
patterns.explanation: Inside a phrase that describes a thing, の can stand in for が. かざんの　おおい　ちほう = 'a region where volcanoes are many'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. うまいぞ = 'it's tasty, I tell you!'
